lang.name: English
lang.choose: 🌐 Choose your language Выберите язык · Tilni tanlang · 언어를 선택하세요
start.welcome: 👋 Hi, {name}! I download videos from social media and send them right here in Telegram — fast and free. 📱 Supported: {platforms} How it works 1️⃣ Send me a video link 2️⃣ Pick a quality 3️⃣ Get your video 🎉 Try it: {example}
help.text: ℹ️ Help • Send a link to a single public video (not a playlist or channel). • Supported: {platforms}. • Pick a quality — sizes shown are estimates. • Follow the progress in the status message; tap 🚫 Cancel to stop. Commands /start — main menu /language — change language /cancel — cancel active downloads /help — this help /about — about the bot Limits • Max file size: {max_mb} MB • Max video length: {max_minutes} min • Up to {max_active} downloads at a time 🔒 Private, deleted, login-only, age-restricted and DRM-protected videos can't be downloaded. 💬 Questions or problems? Write to the admin: @{admin}
about.text: 🤖 About A social media video downloader for Telegram, powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg. 🗑 Videos are processed temporarily and deleted from the server right after delivery. ⚖️ Please only download content you have the right to download. 👨‍💻 Admin: @{admin}
url.hint:
📎 Send me a link to a video from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Twitter/X.

Need help? Tap /help
cb.expired: ⌛ This menu has expired. Please send the link again.
cb.not_yours: This menu belongs to someone else — send your own link.
cb.quality_unavailable: That quality isn't available for this video.
cb.duplicate: This video is already in your queue ✅
cancel.finished: Nothing to cancel — this download already finished.
status.restarting: The server is restarting — your download will resume shortly.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
err.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a valid link. Please send a full http(s) URL.
err.unsupported_url: This link is not supported. Supported: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X.
err.playlist: Playlists and channels aren't supported — please send a link to a single video.
err.invalid_video: No downloadable video was found at this link.
err.live: Live streams and premieres can't be downloaded.
err.unavailable: This video is unavailable — it may be private, deleted or removed.
err.restricted: This content requires login, is age/region restricted, or is DRM protected, so it can't be downloaded.
err.format: The selected quality is not available. Please choose another one.
err.too_long: This video is too long to download.
err.too_large: The video is too large to send via Telegram. Try a lower quality.
err.file_too_large_size: The video is {size}, above Telegram's {limit} limit. Try a lower quality.
err.all_too_large: Every available quality is larger than Telegram's {max_mb} MB limit for bots, so this video can't be sent.
err.download_failed: The download failed. Please try again later.
err.no_video_stream: The downloaded file contains no video.
err.upload: Failed to send the video to Telegram. Please try again later.
err.bot_blocked: The bot was blocked by the user.
err.tg_too_large: The video is too large for Telegram. Try a lower quality.
err.queue: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a minute.
err.too_many: You already have the maximum number of active downloads. Please wait or /cancel one.
err.rate_limited: You're sending links too quickly. Please wait a minute and try again.
err.metadata_timeout: Fetching video info took too long. Please try again.
err.stuck: The download got stuck and was stopped. Please try again.
